name: Gunung Mulu National Park
description: Deep in the rainforest of Sarawak on Borneo, Gunung Mulu National Park is crowned by a 2,377 m sandstone peak and riddled with at least 295 km of explored caves. Millions of swiftlets and bats live inside them, and the Sarawak Chamber, 600 m long and 80 m high, is the largest known cave chamber on Earth. Above ground, the park shelters seventeen vegetation zones and 109 palm species.
